results.name: alt-stone-x-as-state
results.what: the Stone's x is scene state that the position binds to; the colour is a mix of a 0/1 state; the cap is an if

results.name: alt-held-flags-from-events
results.what: the held state is tracked from key_down and key_up handlers (flags) and the motion is bound scene state written in update

results.name: alt-own-clock-in-update
results.what: no fixed_update: an own accumulator in update (cap of 4, whole steps beyond dropped, the fraction kept)

results.what: fixed_update and update write the entities' positions directly (no state, no bind)
